name: Crazy Egg
description: The official Crazy Egg Plugin for Drupal. The easiest, free way to add your Crazy Egg tracking script to your Drupal site.
project_description:
This module provides integration with the Crazy Egg heatmap service.

 This module is very simple and easy to use. Simply install it into your Drupal site (works with Drupal 7 and 8), enter your Crazy Egg account number on the settings form, and save your settings. The module will do the rest!

 In addition to heatmaps, this module enables other features including:

 
 Scrollmaps so you can see where people are scrolling 
 Session recordings that allow you to watch recordings of your visitors interacting with your website. 
 A/B tests so you can set up split tests quickly. 
 
 An integration with Crazy Egg is useful for on-page analytics and split testing. 

 See the attached screenshots.
